name: Farm
uniques: Cannot be built on [Arid] tiles <before discovering [Printing]>

civilopediaText.text: Can be built on Fertile terrains or rich soil, mainly by Farmers.  Provides food, and can improve Crop resources.  Can be built in Arid tiles with the right tech.

name: Slave Farm
uniques: Tile provides yield without assigned population
Cannot be built on [Arid] tiles <before discovering [Printing]>

civilopediaText.text: Farm operated by forced labor, built by Farmers.  Provides a large amount of food without assigned population, and can improve Crop resources.  Can be built in Arid tiles with the right tech.  Disabled after abolition of slavery, turning into a normal Farm.

name: Granary
uniques: Tile provides yield without assigned population
Cannot be built on [Arid] tiles <before discovering [Printing]>
Can only be built <in tiles adjacent to [Farm] tiles>

civilopediaText.text: Agricultural supporting improvement that can be built on fertile tiles or rich soil, mainly by Farmers.  Improves the food output of adjacent Farms.  Can be built in Arid tiles with the right tech.

name: Apothecary
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+15 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Aromatic resources, mainly by Gardeners.  Provides faith and improves the resource.

name: Reedshack
uniques: Can only be built on [resourceless] tiles
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+10 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Marshes on any tile without a resource, mainly by Gardeners.  Provides food and a source of Papyrus.

name: Orchard
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+25 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Edible fruit resources, mainly by Gardeners.  Provides food and improves the resource.

name: Lumber Mill
uniques: Cannot be built on [Strategic resource|Luxury resource|Bonus resource] tiles
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+10 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built in Forests, mainly by Lumberjacks.  Provides a steady supply of Wood.

name: Plantation
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+25 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Plant resources, mainly by Merchants.  Provides Gold and improves the resource.

name: Slave Plantation
uniques: Tile provides yield without assigned population
Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+25 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Plant-based resource upgrade operated by forced labor, mainly by Merchants.  Provides Gold without needing assigned population and improves the resource.  Disabled after abolition.

name: Pasture
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+10 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Herdable bonus Pokémon resources, mainly by Pokémon Breeders.  Provides Food, Gold, and improves the Herdable resource over the tile.

name: Ranch
uniques: Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+10 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Primary food improvement for Arid terrain, mainly built by Pokémon Breeders.  Provides Food, with a higher amount of food when built next to other Pastoral improvements.

name: Hunting Camp
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+10 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Huntable bonus Pokémon resources, mainly by Pokémon Hunters.  Provides Food and improves the resource.

uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Pet bonus Pokémon resources, mainly by Pokémon Breeders.  Provides a significant amount of Production and improves the resource.

Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+10 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Stone supply on Hills operated with Forced Labor, mainly by Diggers.  Provides a large trickle of Stone without assigned population.  Disabled after abolition.

name: Well
uniques: Can only be built on [Fresh Water] tiles

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Fresh Water flatlands, mainly by Diggers.  Provides a steady trickle of Water.

name: Mine
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+25 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Metallic resources, mainly by Prospectors.  Improves the resource, often leading to a large amount of production, and provides gold.

uniques: Tile provides yield without assigned population

civilopediaText.text: Metallic resource upgrading improvement operated by forced labor, mainly by Prospectors.  Improves the resource, often leading to a large amount of production, and provides a large amount of gold, all without requiring assigned population.  Disabled after abolition.

name: Quarry
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource

civilopediaText.text: Can be built over Geologic resources, mainly by Prospectors.  Improves the resource, usually leading to a large amount of production.

name: Slave Quarry
uniques: Tile provides yield without assigned population
Can only be built to improve a resource
Pillaging this improvement yields approximately [+10 Gold]

civilopediaText.text: Geologic resource upgrading improvement operated by forced labor, mainly by Prospectors.  Improves the resource, usually leading to a large amount of production, and providing additional production on top of that, without assigned population.  Costs a large amount of slaves.  Disabled after abolition.

uniques: Tile provides yield without assigned population
Will not be replaced by automated units

civilopediaText.text: Build by Philosophers, these repositories of knowledge can provide science and culture without needing to be worked.  Philosophers can attempt to perform Eurekas over them.
